title: Simultaneous Operations (Simops) Risk Assessment
description: Free Simultaneous Operations (Simops) Risk Assessment template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers simops information, simultaneous operations matrix, current simops activities assessment.
standard: OGP 377 - IADC HSE Guidelines - API RP 75

Stop Work Authority

ANY PERSON HAS THE AUTHORITY AND RESPONSIBILITY TO STOP WORK WHEN:

☐ An unsafe condition is observed

☐ A change in conditions occurs

☐ Communication is lost

☐ A permit violation is observed

☐ Weather exceeds operating limits

☐ An unplanned event occurs

☐ If unsure about safety

STOP WORK PROCEDURE:

1. Immediately stop the task

2. Make the area safe

3. Notify supervisor/SIMOPS coordinator

4. Do not resume until cleared by supervisor
